method: At SG041 stopping time, estimate drift by OLS on nonoverlapping 10-observation bin medians, compute HAC/Newey-West standard error using Bartlett lag 3; nominal 90% interval (z=1.645). Retain SG041 confirmation only when interval excludes 0; retain SG041 rejection only when interval entirely inside ±.0032. Withhold otherwise.

pilot.disclosure: Inspected before freezing; nominal z and HAC lag fixed before fresh holdout.

findings: HAC confirmation gate successfully converted one formerly wrong false rejection into unresolved while preserving both false confirmations and a late-correlation false rejection.
The gate withheld 18 decisions previously correct, increasing total loss relative to SG041.
All three remaining wrong decisions also meet fixed-budget decision rule: observing longer under these conditions does not ensure correct interpretation.
Nominal HAC normal interval assumptions are fragile with only 8-24 bin medians and nonstationary correlation.
limitations: Short-sample HAC/Newey-West intervals do not have guaranteed 90% coverage with nonstationary correlation, high persistence, or oscillations.
The estimator and original classifier share the same observation source. This is not an independent witness.
The threshold +/-0.0032 is a decision margin from the old classifier, not a scientifically determined minimum effect.
Fresh seeds but simulated generator families reused; no blind external observations.
The GitHub source imports SG041 repository source and was re-fetched, but has not been run in a clean checkout.
